title: Estrogenic actions of alkaloids: Structural characteristics and molecular mechanisms.
one_liner_zh: 该文综述雌激素生物碱的结构特征与分子机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This comprehensive review of estrogenic alkaloids reveals that although the number is small, they exhibit a wide range of structures, biosynthesis pathways, mechanisms of action, and applications. Estrogenic alkaloids belong to different classes, different biosynthetic pathways, different estrogenic actions (estrogenic/synergistic, anti-estrogenic/antagonistic, biphasic, and acting as a selective estrogen receptor modulator or SERM), different receptor-initiated signaling pathways, different ways of modulations of estrogen action, and different applications. The future applications of estrogenic alkaloids, such as those for diagnostics, drug development, and therapeutics, are considered with the help of new databases containing comprehensive descriptions of their relationships and more elaborate artificial intelligence-based prediction technologies. Structure-activity studies reveal the significance of the nitrogen atom for their structural and functional diversity, which may help support their broader applications. Based on the summary of previous reports, estrogenic alkaloids have significant potential for future applications.
abstract_zh: 这篇关于雌激素生物碱的全面综述揭示，尽管其数量不多，但它们在结构、生物合成途径、作用机制和应用方面展现出广泛的多样性。雌激素生物碱属于不同类别，具有不同的生物合成途径、不同的雌激素作用（雌激素/协同作用、抗雌激素/拮抗作用、双相作用，以及作为选择性雌激素受体调节剂或SERM发挥作用）、不同的受体启动信号通路、不同的雌激素作用调节方式，以及不同的应用。未来雌激素生物碱的应用，如诊断、药物开发和治疗方面，可借助包含其关系全面描述的新数据库和更精细的基于人工智能的预测技术来加以考虑。结构-活性研究揭示了氮原子对其结构和功能多样性的重要性，这可能有助于支持其更广泛的应用。基于以往报告的总结，雌激素生物碱在未来应用中具有显著潜力。
